description: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment.The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and fostering a culture of compassionate, high-quality care. You will oversee daily operations, financial performance, staff development, and resident satisfaction, driving continuous improvement initiatives.This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to join a dedicated team committed to providing exceptional services. If you are a visionary leader with a passion for long-term care, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license.
Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Demonstrated leadership abilities with a track record of operational success and staff development.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, based on experience and qualifications.
